newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Electric down on weak interim earnings.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Electric down on weak interim earnings.

text.p: Shares in Mitsubishi Electric Corp were down in Wednesday afternoon trade, dragged under by weak interim earnings results, brokers said.

As of 0506 GMT, the shares had lost 19 yen to stand at 672 yen. Mitsubishi Electric was the third most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange with a volume of 4.131 million shares.

Brokers added that electronics manufacturer Toshiba Corp was also being dragged down in tandem with Mitsubishi Electric. Its shares, the fifth most heavily traded, were 11 yen lower at 719 yen on turnover of 2.81 million.
